vulnerabilities.description:
Ferret Scan detected medicare beneficiary identifier in this file.

**Location:** <golden:new_validators_display_formats> (line 1)
**Confidence:** HIGH (95.0%)
**Detected by:** medicalid validator

**Context:**
```
medicare beneficiary 1EG4-TE5-MK73 on card
```

**Additional Information:**
- context_impact: 20

**Remediation:**
Remove the MBI and handle it as PHI under HIPAA, including a breach assessment if it was exposed outside its intended audience.
vulnerabilities.name: Medicare Mbi Detected

**Location:** <golden:new_validators_display_formats> (line 6)
**Confidence:** HIGH (95.0%)
**Detected by:** physical_address validator

**Context:**
```

```

**Additional Information:**

vulnerabilities.description:
Ferret Scan detected date of birth in this file.

**Location:** <golden:new_validators_display_formats> (line 4)
**Confidence:** HIGH (90.0%)
**Detected by:** dob validator

**Context:**
```
patient dob 3/14/87 and sibling born March 14th, 1987
```

**Additional Information:**
- context_impact: 75
- source: preprocessed_content

**Remediation:**
Remove or coarsen the date — a year or age band usually serves the purpose. Combined with a name it is enough to identify most individuals.
vulnerabilities.name: Date Of Birth Detected
